p2_role_feature_leakage.defect: trailing_minutes_share is built by iterating the REALISED box score (data/masters/master_player.parquet filtered to minutes.notna()) and left-merged onto the Tier A candidate universe. A candidate who did not appear has no box-score row for that game and receives NULL.
p2_role_feature_leakage.consequence: role_change.notna() is an EXACT indicator of did_appear. Any operational use of role_change (as a gate, a feature, or a stratum) leaks the appearance outcome perfectly.
p2_role_feature_leakage.ws4_response: WS4 does NOT use this column. It rebuilds the signal with the identical EWMA state machine and constant but reads the state for every candidate on the date instead of only for players in that date's box score.
p2_role_feature_leakage.scope_note: this also affects P2 arms F (prior_role) and I (all groups) on the operational track. Diagnosing or repairing P2 is OUT OF SCOPE for WS4; it is reported here so the defect is on the record.
